newsitem.title: USA: WMX says still seeking new CEO.
newsitem.headline: WMX says still seeking new CEO.

text.p: WMX Technologies Inc said it is still looking for a new chief executive and that it generated $422 million in owners' cash in the first quarter.
"A five-member committee of (the company's) board of directors, chaired by senior director Peer Pedersen, is actively engaged in recruiting a new chief executive officer for the company," WMX said.

The largest U.S. garbage hauler reported on Monday that it earned $178.4 million on sales of $2.2 billion in the first quarter on continuing operations, compared to net income of $180.2 million on sales of $2.14 billion a year ago.

The company said it generated about $422 million in owners' cash on the quarter, including $301 million related to the sale of Waste Management International Inc's 20-percent stake in Wessex Water Plc.
